{{Quote|You'll find Ragtags outside of most Corellia cities and Coronet is no exception. They're usually loitering around on the outskirts of the city. If you find anything about Tomi or my missing shipment, please follow it through.|[[Ral Mundi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />}}
The '''Ragtag bunker''' was a bunker on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] used by the criminal organization known as the [[Ragtags]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located alongside a [[Beach/Legends|beach]] a relatively short distance southwest of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] assaulted the bunker in order to arrest the Ragtag thug [[Tomi Jinsin]] for his involvement in the the theft of a shipment of starship components from [[Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium]]. The Ragtag sentries who patrolled the bunker attacked the spacer and Jinsin was killed in the firefight.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ragtag bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The Ragtag bunker was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> It was part of the quest named "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components", best known as "Ral Mundi's quest".<ref name="SWG:TTE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components"</ref> Ral Mundi's quest was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />
